mapper.select: SELECT s.strategy_id, s.account_id, a.user_id AS owner_user_id, s.instrument_id, i.instrument_ticker, i.currency AS instrument_currency, s.side, s.quantity, s.trigger_direction, s.trigger_price, s.armed, s.valid_from, s.valid_until, s.max_order_value, s.max_position_qty, s.max_executions, s.max_failures, s.executions, s.consecutive_failures FROM strategy s JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = s.instrument_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = s.account_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.instrument_ticker = #{ticker} ORDER BY s.strategy_id
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy SET armed = TRUE, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND armed = FALSE

UPDATE strategy SET status = 'EXECUTING', claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND armed = TRUE AND executions < max_executions AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE strategy SET claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'EXECUTING' AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: UPDATE strategy SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, status = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_failures THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, status_reason = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_failures THEN LEFT('Stopped after ' || max_failures || ' failed attempts in a row. Last problem: ' || CAST(#{reason} AS VARCHAR), 200) ELSE LEFT(CAST(#{reason} AS VARCHAR), 200) END, claimed_at = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'EXECUTING' RETURNING status
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy SET executions = executions + 1, consecutive_failures = 0, last_order_id = #{orderId}, status_reason = NULL, armed = FALSE, claimed_at = NULL, status = CASE WHEN status = 'EXECUTING' THEN CASE WHEN executions + 1 >= max_executions THEN 'EXECUTED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END ELSE status END, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_run (strategy_id, run_number, quote_price, quote_at, outcome, order_id, detail) VALUES ( #{run.strategyId}, #{run.runNumber}, #{run.quotePrice}, #{run.quoteAt}, #{run.outcome}, #{run.orderId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, LEFT(CAST(#{run.detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), 200) )

INSERT INTO strategy_run (strategy_id, run_number, quote_price, quote_at, outcome, detail) SELECT CAST(#{run.strategyId} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{run.runNumber} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{run.quotePrice} AS NUMERIC(19, 4)), CAST(#{run.quoteAt} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), 'STALE', LEFT(CAST(#{run.detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), 200) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_run WHERE strategy_id = #{run.strategyId} AND outcome = 'STALE' AND created_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' )
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy_run SET settled_status = #{settledStatus}, settled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND run_number = #{runNumber} AND outcome IN ('ORDERED', 'DUPLICATE') AND settled_status IS NULL

UPDATE strategy SET status = 'EXPIRED', status_reason = 'The window closed before it finished', version = version + 1 WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DISABLED') AND valid_until IS NOT NULL AND valid_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE strategy SET status = 'ACTIVE', claimed_at = NULL, status_reason = 'Recovered after an interrupted run', version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'EXECUTING' AND claimed_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (CAST(#{seconds} AS BIGINT) * INTERVAL '1 second')
